name: Camping Zwerwald
beschreibung: The campsite Camping Zwerwald is situated in the Tyrolean Alps at an altitude of approximately 1,000 metres, encircled by fragrant forests and meadows. The site offers pitches for motorhomes, tents, and seasonal visitors. Facilities include sanitary amenities, a cosy restaurant, and a children's playground. Scenic hiking trails traverse the nearby mountain landscape. The campsite is open from May to September.
